title: Better Hardcore Resource Pack
description: Resource pack required for Better Hardcore Datapack.
body:
The official Resource Pack requiered for [Better Hardcore Datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bh-dp)'s features to work properly.

![Welcome to Better Hardcore.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9013950e98c6207b78250d85b36efe8b4837f992.webp)

Better Hardcore is a modification which aims to enhance Minecraft's difficulty to a challenging, but possible one. You can learn more about Better Hardcore in the [datapack page](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bh-dp).

## ⚙️ Installation Guide
1. Open the resource packs menu from the game settings.
2. Click on add a new resource pack and drop the _BH_RP.zip_ file. Then, enable it.
3. Start the creation of the new world with the [Better Hardcore Datapack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bh-dp) loaded in.
4. To do so, select data packs, open the temporary drop file folder and drop the datapack file there. Then, enable it.
5. Load into the world. You should receive a message confirming the datapack has loaded in.

## Features & Additions
Some of Better Hardcore's changes requiere the usage of this resource pack:
- Hardcore darkness shader
- Custom item textures
- Font changes to support Energy/Stamina bar symbols

## Why do you need it?
For the best experience, use the resource pack together with the datapack. Using only the datapack will result in odd symbols that stand for the UI elements and no custom textures. Custom items will appear as command blocks.
